verdict.rationale: Clerky is a legal-paperwork SaaS, so background automations are a fair question for it. However, no evidence shows Clerky itself offers scheduled, triggered, or autonomous background workflows. The Partner API (create, fill, poll document sets, with OAuth access still 'coming soon') and the read-only MCP server are developer and assistant building blocks, not product-native automations, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
